goal: Build a pure as-of 4h signal generator from pinned OHLCV (not ledger-derived episode indices), then compare independently generated entry and exit CLOSED-candle indices against frozen prior 47 Bybit baseline positions. Fail closed on any discrepancy; no orders or broker connection.

source.venue: Bybit BTCUSDT spot historical frozen 4h 6-column candles
source.sampling: 14400000 ms continuous rows in UTC, full close confirmation required

indicator.z: Z[j]=(C[j]-mean(C[j-40:j]))/population_std(C[j-40:j]), computed after candle j fully closes, no current price in mean/std
indicator.raw_target: hysteretic state: if Z<=-2, desired=1; else if Z>=0, desired=0; between thresholds retain prior raw state. No pre-40 signals.
indicator.momentum30: At the FIRST BAR of each raw-positive contiguous episode j, admit iff j>=180 and C[j]>=C[j-180]; if rejected keep whole raw episode blocked until raw=0. No delayed episode reentry.
indicator.final_target: raw state 1 throughout admitted episode, else zero; natural exit when final_target switches from 1 to 0. Place intent at next bar open, not a fill.
indicator.number_type: high precision Decimal population std core and separate float population std cross-check on original historical price rows; drift or threshold disagreements fail closed
indicator.asof: No open/low/high of future j+1 bars used to make signals; no unconfirmed or nonmonotonic bars accepted.
indicator.partial_windows: For comparison, replay entire pinned continuous input once, then restrict first-target transitions to exact pre-registered windows. If boundary carry-in changes event counts, FAIL and investigate, do not trim adaptively.

acceptance: Exactly 25/25 train and 22/22 evaluation independent first-target entry and natural-exit signal indices equal SHA-pinned prior ledger (all 94 timing points), with no extras, exact next-open j+1 timestamp alignment, 1:1 match per episode; complete candle history prefix invariance and fail-closed gap/unconfirmed tests. Fail does not authorize any Paper changes.
scope_limits: Event indexes must originate exclusively from market OHLCV, NOT from old decisions, previous positions, old core code or outcome labels.
Frozen ledger is read only AFTER independent market computations as an oracle.
This is independent signal/timing parity on seen history, not a profitable strategy, fill, trade, PnL, DD, market impact or source-quality proof.
Neither Bitget nor LBank public market backup is valid as a Bybit signal execution surrogate.
